{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Value and Momentum Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high book-to-market ratios and strong momentum tend to outperform due to overreaction and underreaction to news.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Profitability and Investment Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high profitability and low investment tend to outperform due to efficient allocation of resources.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "GP"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Earnings Quality and Accruals Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high earnings quality and low accruals tend to outperform due to reduced risk of earnings manipulation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Accruals"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "AbnormalAccruals", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},
{"name": "Leverage and Liquidity Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with low leverage and high liquidity tend to outperform due to reduced risk of financial distress.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Momentum and Reversal Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with strong momentum and subsequent reversal tend to outperform due to overreaction to news.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "STreversal"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Quality and Volatility Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high quality and low volatility tend to outperform due to reduced risk of earnings surprises.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "RealizedVol"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Value and Profitability Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high book-to-market ratios and high profitability tend to outperform due to efficient allocation of resources.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "GP"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "AbnormalAccruals", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},
{"name": "Leverage and Earnings Quality Composite", 
"mechanism": "Firms with low leverage and high earnings quality tend to outperform due to reduced risk of financial distress and earnings manipulation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Leverage"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "PS"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}
]}
